text: All traffic uses v1, the control. Its illustrative p95 latency is 120 ms; the unexposed candidate has no result.
The router allocates twenty percent to the candidate. Three stylized four-to-one traffic cycles begin; the animated packets are not a statistical sample.
The candidate’s illustrative p95 is 900 ms, compared with 120 ms for the control. Its work bar remains busy longer.
The 7.5-fold latency difference is highlighted. ROLLBACK appears at 17.4 seconds and a signal returns to the router; the share bar moves back to the control from 18 seconds.
New requests use the control. The candidate receives zero percent, and its failed latency result remains visible. The stage fades from 24 seconds, retaining the title for the loop.
